items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: There was a guy come in the club about two weeks ago, his name was Alexandra. He says, your brothers have got a pretty good band.

ctx.x: I said to Merritt, I said, holy or not Merritt, he says, 62. He says, that's not my age, that's the weather temperature I'd say.

There was a guy come in the club about two weeks ago, his name was Alexandra. He says, your brothers have got a pretty good band. He says, they played for our convention down in Bilox at the Buena Vista. He says, they got a pretty good band for a bunch of guys. He says, but tell me, how does your brother get music out of that patched up trombone he's got? Yeah, it's all patched up with tape. I'm going to buy him one and send him one. He likes it, he's used to it. Did you ever play a valve trombone? Did you ever…
Did you ever play a valve trombone?
